lines.en: I waddle along
My webbed feet slap the ground
Walking the waterline, feet dry.
At the water I float
My neck stretches and shrinks
I head for the seeding grass
Two little ones follow me
I cross a patch of shallow mud
I am not fast, and I sway a lot
I push the grass aside with my bill
I make little sound walking
I went around that puddle
I follow the field ridge
I walk with my head down, looking for food

lines.zh: 我边走边摆尾，泥里留下脚印。
lines.en: Walking, I wag my tail, leaving prints in the mud.
Two steps, then I stop

lines.zh: 我漂在睡莲间，脚在水下划。
lines.en: I drift among lilies, feet paddling below.
I tuck my head into my feathers
Rings spread on the water around me
I paddle slowly without moving on
A sound on the bank, and I look

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是浮着
lines.en: I do nothing but float
The sun warms my back
I tilt my head
The water here is shallow
My feathers carry a little water
I am preening my chest
Waterweed touches my belly
I let out a quack
The wind wrinkles the water
It is safe here
I have nowhere to go
You stand too close to the water
I mean no harm
Can I eat what you are holding

lines.zh: 我退到芦苇边，脖子缩了缩。
lines.en: I back to the reeds and tuck my neck in.
The water is safer than the bank
Come closer and I take to the water

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就往水里挪。
lines.en: When you come close, I edge toward the water.

lines.zh: 我眨着圆眼，把你从头看到脚。
lines.en: Blinking my round eyes, I look you up and down.
I come to this bank often

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩得泥水乱溅，我怕。
lines.en: Your boots splash mud everywhere. I'm scared.
Floating is enough for me
I will come ashore once you leave
I quack and run

lines.zh: 被揍得掉毛，我嘎嘎叫着跑。
lines.en: Feathers knocked loose, I quack and run.
I flap toward the water
That made me tilt
I hide behind the reeds
I am small, I cannot take hits

lines.zh: 四滴血的鸭子，抖了抖毛。
lines.en: A four-health duck ruffles its feathers.
I walk slowly back
I am not hurt, only frightened
I will keep my distance after this
Is that wheat you are holding
Scatter it on the ground, I will peck
That bit in your hand smells good

lines.zh: 我摆着尾巴，一晃一晃凑近。
lines.en: Wagging my tail, I waddle nearer.
Do not reach out, I get scared
Too few crumbs. Scatter another handful.
Scatter it wider so I can find it
I peck once and go
Step back a little and I will come
This can be eaten in the water too
Let me look first
Is that rice in your hand
My neck stretched a little
If it hits the water I will grab it
One quack and the water's all ripples
Lower your hand a bit
You stepped on my webbed foot
I quack and run for the water

lines.zh: 被你一撞，我翅下飘出绒毛。
lines.en: Your bump shakes loose down from under my wings.
That made me sway hard
Excuse me. I'm heading to that pond.
I will walk around you
We bumped and both stepped back
Don't push — my feathers are a mess.
I flap my wings twice
The water is roomier
There are other ducks by the water
We float together
It swims a little faster than I do
We bob our heads at each other

lines.zh: 岸边的草够我们一起啄
lines.en: There is enough grass for both of us
Our calls sound like quarreling
We bump into each other walking

lines.zh: 水面上有我们两个影子
lines.en: Two shadows on the water

lines.zh: 后来它们都跟在我们后面
lines.en: Later the little ones follow us both
Tomorrow we will still be at this bank
I peck it up
Too small, I cannot peck it
It is stuck in my bill
I swallowed it
I carry what floats by.
I check everything that falls on the ground

lines.zh: 我用蹼拨开浮萍，找下面的食。
lines.en: I paddle the duckweed aside to find food below.

lines.zh: 这硬壳咬不开，我吐出来。
lines.en: This shell won't crack. I spit it out.

lines.zh: 这粒石子不能吃，我甩开。
lines.en: This pebble isn't food. I toss it away.
I can find things dropped in the water too
My feathers are yellow.

lines.zh: 水面上的我，只有四点生命。
lines.en: Four health, floating on the water.
I hear a sound in the grass
If there is food, I go
I walk two steps that way
I will not go far

lines.zh: 水边的东西我都看得见
lines.en: I see everything along the bank
I know this smell

lines.zh: 我探头探脑，朝你脚边挪。
lines.en: Craning my neck, I shuffle toward your feet.

lines.zh: 我歪头看清你，再决定跑不跑。
lines.en: I tilt my head, size you up, then decide whether to run.
I shuffle over in small steps
My neck stretches out
Progress is easier in the water
There are seeds in the grass
A little closer
I tilt my head to be sure
There is no danger here
I step and pause
Everything else can wait
Almost caught up now
My flat bill pecks the back of your hand.
I flap my wings
That was light
I kick with a foot

lines.zh: 我除了啄，就只会扑翅膀。
lines.en: Besides pecking, I can only flap my wings.
You backed off, good
I stepped back two paces myself
Just one peck. Don't chase me.
My wing aches a little
I will go back to the water
I settle onto the water

lines.zh: 芦苇丛里水很浅，正好落脚。
lines.en: The water is shallow in the reeds, just right for landing.
I flap my wings twice

lines.zh: 低头理了理背上的羽毛。
lines.en: I smooth the feathers on my back.
Grass on the bank, good
I paddle over to the reeds
One, two of us came down together
I do not know this place
I test the depth of the water first

lines.zh: 我落在池塘里，水花溅了一身。
lines.en: I land in the pond, splashing water over myself.
The fire made me beat my wings wildly

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，摔在水里
lines.en: I fell and hit the water
I cannot stay afloat
The blast threw me onto the bank

lines.zh: 飞来的东西擦过我的翼
lines.en: Something flying grazed my wing
That force held me down
Nothing to eat, and I grow lighter
Lightning lit the whole water
There is no water to float on in the void
